vignette: Priya and Marcus are visiting a ski resort for the weekend. After a long day on the slopes, they're back at the lodge when Priya pulls out a tube of chapstick. Marcus mentions that the mountain air has left his lips feeling dry, and that he forgot to pack any himself.
reward_low: Marcus's lips feel a little dry, but he's not particularly bothered by it.
reward_high: Marcus's lips are cracked and painful, and without chapstick they will keep getting worse overnight.
action_0: Marcus does not use any of Priya's chapstick. He drinks some water instead and hopes his lips will feel better in the morning.
action_1: Priya wipes the top of the chapstick firmly with a napkin to strip off the exposed surface, and then hands the tube to Marcus to apply from the fresh layer underneath.
action_2: Marcus swipes his finger across the chapstick, and uses his finger to apply it to his own lips.
action_3: Marcus applies the chapstick directly to his own lips from the tube.

vignette: Amira and Logan meet up at a public pool on a summer afternoon. After swimming, they get out of the water and Logan realizes he forgot to pack a towel in his bag. Amira has brought a large beach towel.
reward_low: It's warm enough out that Logan doesn't really mind air drying.
reward_high: Logan is starting to shiver from the wind, and he needs to dry off quickly to warm up.
action_0: Logan does not use Amira's towel. He lets the sun air-dry him while he waits on the pool deck.
action_1: Amira uses one end to dry herself, and Logan uses the far end, each keeping to their own half so their drying surfaces don't overlap.
action_2: Amira dries herself off using the whole towel, and then hands the damp towel to Logan, who dries himself with it.
action_3: Amira uses the towel to dry Logan's back and shoulders, and Logan uses it to dry Amira's — they actively dry each other off with the same towel.

vignette: Daphne and Wesley are partway through a long hike. The sun is getting strong, and Wesley realizes he forgot to bring a hat. Daphne is wearing her own cap and has a spare in her pack — one she wore on yesterday's hike. She forgot to take it out of the pack to dry, so the hat is still damp with sweat from her own head.
reward_low: The sun is mild enough that Wesley isn't particularly bothered by being out in it without a hat.
reward_high: The sun is strong, and Wesley knows he'll get a bad headache without a hat.
action_0: Wesley does not wear Daphne's spare hat.
action_1: Daphne pulls a clean bandana from her pack. Wesley ties it around his head as a head wrap, and then puts the spare hat on over it so the bandana sits between his head and the hat.
action_2: Daphne ties the spare hat to her pack to dry it out, and once it's dry she hands it to Wesley to wear.
action_3: Daphne hands the spare hat directly to Wesley, who pulls it onto his own head with the hat still damp from her hair and skin.

vignette: Celeste and Tamsin are getting ready together in a hotel room before a wedding. Celeste has been blow-drying and brushing her hair. Tamsin realizes that she forgot to pack her hairbrush.
reward_low: Tamsin's hair is fairly low-maintenance, and she'll look fine without brushing it out.
reward_high: Tamsin's hair has gotten especially tangled, and she really needs to brush it thoroughly to look presentable.
action_0: Tamsin does not use the hairbrush. She runs her fingers through her hair and uses a bit of water to smooth it.
action_1: Celeste runs the brush under hot water with shampoo, rinses it, and dries it thoroughly. She gives the cleaned brush to Tamsin.
action_2: Celeste pulls the loose strands of hair out of the bristles and runs the brush under the tap. She hands it to Tamsin, who uses it.
action_3: Celeste brushes her own hair and then passes the brush directly to Tamsin, who uses it without cleaning it.

vignette: Jonas and Derek are at a casual jam session in a friend's backyard. Jonas has been playing a harmonica, and Derek mentions he hasn't tried one in years and would be curious to play a few notes. There's no other harmonica around.
reward_low: Derek feels a mild curiosity, but could happily take or leave trying the harmonica.
reward_high: Derek has been meaning to learn harmonica for years, and he's genuinely excited to finally try one.
action_0: Derek does not play the harmonica. He claps along to the music instead and waits for someone to pass him a different instrument.
action_1: Jonas passes the harmonica to Derek. Derek wipes the mouthpiece of the harmonica down thoroughly with a sanitizing alcohol wipe, working it over each hole, before playing the harmonica.
action_2: Jonas passes the harmonica to Derek. Derek wipes down the harmonica with a napkin, before playing the harmonica.
action_3: Jonas passes the harmonica to Derek. Derek directly plays the harmonica without wiping it down.

vignette: Zara and Ben are at the beach for the afternoon. Ben mentions that he can't reach his own back to apply sunscreen and asks Zara if she could help. Zara has a can of spray-on sunscreen and a tube of sunscreen lotion.
reward_low: It's fairly overcast, and Ben doesn't think he's at much risk of burning.
reward_high: The sun is strong, and Ben knows his back will burn badly if it isn't covered.
action_0: Ben does not get sunscreen on his back.
action_1: Zara sprays the spray-on sunscreen over Ben's back from about a foot away, covering it evenly with the aerosol.
action_2: Zara sprays the sunscreen onto her own hand and then pats it across Ben's back with quick light touches to even out the coverage.
action_3: Zara squeezes sunscreen lotion onto her own bare hands and rubs it into Ben's back thoroughly.

vignette: Anaya and Kai are at an outdoor movie screening in the park. About twenty minutes into the film, the temperature drops sharply — much more than they had expected. Anaya brought one large blanket.
reward_low: Neither of them feels particularly cold; their jackets are enough for now.
reward_high: They are both shivering, and without some way to stay warm they won't be able to enjoy the rest of the movie.
action_0: They do not share the blanket for warmth. They pull their jackets tighter and keep their hands in their pockets.
action_1: They each drape half of the blanket over their shoulders, sitting with a clear gap of grass between them.
action_2: They move closer to each other and each drape half of the blanket over their shoulders, with their shoulders touching.
action_3: They move closer to each other and wrap the blanket fully around both of them, sitting shoulder-to-shoulder with the blanket cocooning them together.

vignette: Gabriel and Henry are on a two-night backpacking trip in Yosemite. On the first evening, while setting up their tent, Gabriel accidentally drops his sleeping bag in a stream. It's now soaking wet and will take all night to dry.
reward_low: The night is expected to be mild, and Gabriel thinks he can sleep fine wrapped in his jacket.
reward_high: The night is expected to be cold and uncomfortable without insulation, and Gabriel really needs proper warmth to sleep.
action_0: Gabriel does not use Henry's sleeping bag. He wraps himself in his jackets and tries to sleep on his pad alone.
action_1: They unzip the bag fully and use it as a flat shared blanket, draped across both of their sleeping pads, with a small gap kept between the pads so their bodies don't touch.
action_2: They push their sleeping pads together so the pads are touching, and use the unzipped bag as a shared blanket over both of them, their bodies side-by-side under the bag.
action_3: They both sleep inside Henry's sleeping bag together, pressed against each other for warmth.

vignette: Ines and Sofia are staying at an Airbnb over the weekend for a retreat. When they arrive, they realize that only one full-size bed remains unclaimed.
reward_low: Neither of them particularly cares where they sleep; the couch in the living room would be fine too.
reward_high: They are both exhausted from the long drive and really want a proper bed to sleep in.
action_0: One of them takes the couch, and one of them takes the bed.
action_1: They both sleep on the bed, but they put pillows between them on the bed and get separate blankets.
action_2: They both sleep on the bed under the same blanket, but they leave space between them and do not touch.
action_3: They both sleep on the bed under the same blanket, with their shoulders touching.

vignette: Maya and Samira are at the office gym together before their first meeting of the day. Afterward, they head into the locker room to change out of their workout clothes. The locker room has a private changing stall in one corner and a long open bench area for changing in the middle.
reward_low: They have plenty of time before the meeting and could easily wait their turn or take their time.
reward_high: They realize they are both late for the meeting, so they need to change quickly.
action_0: They each wait their turn to change in the private stall.
action_1: They change at opposite sides of the open bench area, and make sure to not see each other undressed.
action_2: They change in the open bench area side by side, but they don't look at each other while changing so they don't see each other undressed.
action_3: They change at the open bench area side-by-side while having a conversation, facing each other and undressing in full view of each other.

vignette: Ronan and Aaron are at a wellness retreat that includes access to a traditional Finnish sauna, which is customarily used nude (though guests can wrap in a towel if they prefer). Everyone in the group is invited to use it. When they arrive at the sauna hut, they find that they are the only two people there — everyone else has gone to different activities.
reward_low: Neither of them is especially in the mood for a sauna right now — they'd happily postpone and come back another time.
reward_high: They are both really looking forward to the sauna — it's one of the main experiences they came to the retreat for.
action_0: Neither of them uses the sauna. They agree to come back later when other people are around, and go for a walk in the meantime.
action_1: They take turns in the sauna one at a time — one goes in while the other waits in the lounge, and then they switch off.
action_2: They both go in at the same time, each fully wrapped in a towel, and sit on opposite benches at a distance from each other.
action_3: They both go in at the same time following the traditional nude sauna practice, sitting near each other on the same bench.

vignette: Tessa is visiting Naomi's city and they meet up for coffee. Both of them have approximately kept up with each other through social media, but haven't talked in person for a long time. They know from the grapevine that both of them have been going through breakups.
reward_low: Neither of them is particularly interested in talking about their breakup.
reward_high: Their breakups are recent and they want to process it with someone who has been going through something similar.
action_0: They don't bring up either breakup. They catch up on work, mutual friends, and other lighter topics for the rest of the meet-up.
action_1: They each briefly acknowledge their breakup, but neither goes into details. They quickly move the conversation back to lighter topics.
action_2: They each share the basic story of their breakup — what happened and where things stand now — and listen to each other.
action_3: They each share everything about their breakup, including the harder parts — the worst moments, the things they regret, the fears they haven't said out loud. They keep talking through it together long past their original meet-up time.

vignette: Asha and Eli are at a vintage market together. Eli sees a set of curtains he interested in buying. However, he realizes that because he just moved to the country, he can't yet pay for the item because he doesn't have a bank account in the country set up. The bank account is necessary for accessing the payment app that the vendor uses. Asha has her payment app set up on her phone.
reward_low: Eli is mildly interested in the item but could easily pass on it.
reward_high: Eli has been searching for this exact item for years and really wants to buy it now.
action_0: Eli does not buy the item. He decides to pass on it and they continue browsing.
action_1: Asha pays for the curtains from her account. They keep careful track of the exact amount, and Eli will pay her back in full as soon as his local bank account is set up next week.
action_2: Asha pays for the curtains from her account. They don't track the exact amount — Eli will pick up the cost of their next dinner together or a similar shared expense to balance things out informally over time.
action_3: Asha pays for the curtains from her account. They don't track it at all. They cover for each other often enough that they don't bother keeping score of who paid for what.

vignette: Wren and Oscar are meeting up for dinner. The conversation eventually turns to mutual friends and acquaintances, and what's been going on in their lives.
reward_low: Neither of them feels much need to get into the details of other people's situations tonight.
reward_high: They're both eager to compare notes — there's been a lot going on in their wider social circle and they want to discuss it.
action_0: They keep the conversation general and change the topic quickly.
action_1: They share surface-level updates about mutual acquaintances — public facts about who's married, moved, changed jobs.
action_2: They share their own opinions and judgments about people in their wider circle, and also share details that are personal but aren't exactly private secrets.
action_3: They share their most honest takes on people in their wider circle, and also share personal and sensitive details about other people's lives, trusting each other to keep those things private.

vignette: Vera and Ivy know each other from college. Vera is in town for the day with a few hours to kill between meetings, and she's near Ivy's apartment. Ivy's apartment is in its current real state — laundry on the floor, dishes from yesterday in the sink, books and personal items scattered around.
reward_low: It's a nice day out and Vera would be comfortable spending the time at a sidewalk cafe or walking around the neighborhood.
reward_high: It's pouring rain outside and Vera really wants to be somewhere warm and dry rather than hopping between coffee shops for the next few hours.
action_0: Vera doesn't come in. They text hello and Vera spends the next few hours waiting at a coffee shop on her own.
action_1: Ivy quickly tidies the apartment before Vera arrives. Vera spends the next few hours hanging out in the cleaned living room.
action_2: Vera comes in without Ivy tidying first. She spends the next few hours hanging out in the living room and kitchen as they are. The bedroom door stays closed and she doesn't go in.
action_3: Vera comes in to the apartment in its full real state and makes herself at home for the next few hours — she has the run of every room, including the bedroom with the unmade bed and the bathroom with personal items out.

vignette: Nadia and Ravi are driving to an out-of-town wedding together. Nadia is at the wheel, Ravi is in the passenger seat, and they've been using Nadia's phone for directions. About halfway through the drive, they're considering whether to add a restaurant stop on the way for a quick meal before continuing on.
reward_low: Neither of them is particularly hungry; they could easily wait until they reach their destination to eat.
reward_high: They are both starving and really want to eat — the wedding reception won't serve food for several more hours.
action_0: Neither of them adds a stop on the phone. They keep driving straight to the wedding without stopping to eat.
action_1: Nadia unlocks her phone, opens the maps app, and hands the phone to Ravi to find a restaurant and add it as a stop. Ravi works only within the maps app, and if the phone locks again before he's done, he hands it back to Nadia to unlock.
action_2: Nadia unlocks her phone, and hands it to Ravi. Ravi goes on the maps app to find restaurants and also goes on the browser on Nadia's phone to look up details of the restaurants.
action_3: Nadia hands her phone to Ravi, who types in her passcode and uses her phone to find and look up details of the restaurants.
